Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be done every 
 three months as indicated by M3 in the title block.
Technical Specifications:
The first draft is 
 initiated by eng. Mahmoud Derar, tested by eng. Bahaa Abd-Elwahab, revised by 
 MDEPCo. Quality control eng. Adel El Naggar, accepted by general manager eng. Mohamed 
 El-Sherif, approved by eng. Ahmed Sawan head sector of Nubaria PS.
This document is certified by eng. Samir Abd El Gillil MDEPC quality control 
 general director and approved by eng. Mohammed Nageb inspection and quality 
 head sector.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued
The maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable ID safety category
Safety fence with caution marks to surround the work area.
Wear 
 the safety and healthy equipment as: safety 
 helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs .... etc

and Equipment
Brushes
AVO meter
Blower
Cleaning fluids such as Freon 
 TF. chlorothene.
Allen key
Screws
Work to be 
carried out
Check the supply voltage(220 Vac)
Check the feed back signal
Clean the positioner
Close the work permit
